title: How the 2026 Browns Defense Plans to SURVIVE Without Myles Garrett
description:
The Cleveland Browns face their biggest defensive challenge in a decade: surviving without Myles Garrett. After trading the two-time Defensive Player of the Year to the Rams on June 2nd, 2026, the Browns are rebuilding their identity in training camp with Jared Verse, Isaiah McGuire, and a secondary led by newly-extended stars Denzel Ward and Grant Delpit. Can this defense remain elite without a generational pass rusher? We break down the historical parallels from the Dawg Pound 1980s, the current camp battles, and whether scheme and attitude can replace raw talent. This is the post-Garrett era, and the franchise's identity hangs in the balance.
